ability_arrays.name: Hybrid Build
ability_arrays.description: Strong in half of the stats, weaker in the other half.

ability_arrays.name: Prodigy Build
ability_arrays.description: Excellent in some stats, very weak in the others.

ability_arrays.name: Backbone Build
ability_arrays.description: One strong stat and the rest reliable.

ability_arrays.name: Jack of All Trades
ability_arrays.description: Good at everything, but excels at none.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: When you use a ranged or throwable weapon, your current reach is: {reach}. You can still attack farther than that, but each range step beyond your current reach gives the roll one stack of disadvantage

born_of_soil.name: Born of Soil
born_of_soil.description: You learned your magic in a place whose spirits are strong and ancient. When shapeshifting, you may take the shape of any animal that could naturally live in one of your attuned lands. Regardless of your form, you magically retain your stats. Choose a tell that marks you as born of the soil. You may spend 1 AT to hide or suppress your tell for one hour. {wild_die_text}

empowerments.name: Additional Attuned Land
empowerments.description: Choose one additional attuned land. When shapeshifting, you may also turn into animals that could naturally live in that land.

steps.text_value: When you are in an appropriate animal form, add your current wild die: d4. Use it on suitable Agility, Strength, Instinct, or Finesse checks, with GM approval. Wild dice do not explode.
When you are in an appropriate animal form, add your current wild die: d6. Use it on suitable Agility, Strength, Instinct, or Finesse checks, with GM approval. Wild dice do not explode.

When you are in an appropriate animal form, add your current wild die: d8.
Use it on suitable Agility, Strength, Instinct, or Finesse checks, with GM approval. Wild dice do not explode.

When you are in an appropriate animal form, add your current wild die: d10.
Use it on suitable Agility, Strength, Instinct, or Finesse checks, with GM approval. Wild dice do not explode.

wild_eyes.name: Wild Eyes
wild_eyes.description:
When you mark an animal with mud, dirt, or blood.
You can see through the animal's eyes as if they were your own, no matter how far away it is.
You may only have one animal at a time. If you mark a new animal, the old mark ends.

wild_empathy.name: Wild Empathy
wild_empathy.description: You can speak with and understand animals. You can ask animals what they saw, heard, smelled, fear, want, or know from their surroundings. Animals still think like animals, so their answers may be simple, instinctive, or limited.

empowerments.name: Thing Talker
empowerments.description: You can also speak with the spirits of objects and plants. Old objects and plants may know useful things about their surroundings or past, but they only understand the world from their own limited point of view.

communion_of_whispers.name: Communion of Whispers
communion_of_whispers.description: When you spend time in a place and call on the ancient spirits of the land, the GM gives you a vision that matters to you, your allies, or the spirits nearby. The vision is unclear unless you spend 1 AT. If you spend 1 AT, the vision becomes clear and useful.

empowerments.name: Animist
empowerments.description: Once per location, you may ask for a clear vision about one specific interest, with GM approval. You may spend 1 AT to gain one additional vision in that same location.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.description: When you stay still in natural surroundings, enemies cannot spot you until you move, with GM approval. Even after you move, you have advantage on checks to avoid being noticed in natural surroundings.

animal_buddy.name: Animal Buddy
animal_buddy.description: You gain an animal companion. Your buddy acts like a simple player character, but it does not level up or buy improvements. When your buddy helps you with a check, add your current buddy die: d{buddy_die}. Your buddy has {buddy_hearts} Heart(s) and BDV equal to half your BDV, rounded up.

options.name: Well Trained
options.description: Choose one of your buddy's abilities and increase its static bonus by +1. The first bonus to an ability costs 1 IP, the second costs 2 IP, then 3 IP, and so on.

options.name: Gifted
options.description: Choose an additional perk for your buddy.

buddy_hearts.name: Extra Heart
buddy_hearts.description: Your Animal Buddy gains 1 additional Heart.

martial_feats.name: Martial Feats
martial_feats.description: When you roll with a weapon and declare a martial deed, add your current Martial Die: d{martial_die}. If the martial die rolls 3 or higher, you may impose a reasonable deed, condition, or narrative consequence, with GM approval. The effect usually lasts until the start of your side's next turn. Martial dice do not explode.

shoot_first.name: Shoot First
shoot_first.description: You are never caught by surprise. When an enemy would get the drop on you, you get to act first instead.

trap_expert.name: Trap Expert
trap_expert.description: When you survey a dangerous area, you may ask the GM one honest question about traps, hazards, or environmental dangers. You may spend AT to ask additional questions, if the GM agrees they are relevant.

sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack.description: When you hit an enemy who is surprised, distracted, or otherwise exposed, choose one Sneak Attack effect. You may choose one additional effect for each AT you spend. Base effects: - They have some sort of disadvantage on their next turn. - You create some sort of advantage you or an ally can act on. - You slip into a hiding place immediately after the attack, with GM approval. - You deal extra HP of damage to the target. Your current extra damage option deals +{sneak_attack_damage} HP damage. The exact effect must fit the attack, the target, and the situation.

options.name: Hobbled
options.description: Add this option to your Sneak Attack effect list: The target is hobbled and slow-moving. The range they can move is reduced by one range level.

options.name: Drop Item
options.description: Add this option to your Sneak Attack effect list: The target drops anything they are holding.

options.name: Stunned and Drooling
options.description: Add this option to your Sneak Attack effect list: The target does nothing but stand and drool for a few moments. They cannot act on their side's next turn.

sneak_attack_damage.name: Sneak Attack Damage
sneak_attack_damage.description: Your current Sneak Attack extra damage option deals +{sneak_attack_damage} HP damage. You only use this when you choose the extra damage effect.

spin_attack.name: Spin Attack
spin_attack.description: Spend 1 AT to make one combat roll against all enemies within melee range. On each target you hit, either inflict a status effect or deal damage.

trick_shot.name: Trick Shot
trick_shot.description: Spend 1 AT to target a location with a ranged weapon without direct line of sight, if you have line of sight to a bounce point. Add one extra bounce per extra AT spent.

blow_out_the_sun.name: Blow Out the Sun
blow_out_the_sun.description: When you volley with a ranged weapon, spend AT before rolling. For each AT spent, choose one extra target. Roll once and apply damage to all targets.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: By touching someone skin to skin and channeling magic, you may heal them. Your current healing amount is {healing_dice} damage levels, or {halved_hp} halved HP, or one narrative injury. You may heal each person once per long rest. To heal the same person again before the next long rest, spend {repeat_healing_cost} AT. You also have advantage when stabilizing dying creatures.

physician.name: Physician
physician.description: Given enough time and supplies, you can medically treat any creature you understand.Clear an additional 2 HP during a rest, once per person each day cycle.You have advantage when stabilizing dying creatures.

hearty.name: Hearty
hearty.description: Gain +{hp_per_heart} HP for every heart you have or gain.

deity.name: Deity
deity.description: After quiet communion with your deity, you gain useful knowledge. When petitioning according to your religion, spend AT to be granted a boon related to your deity's domain. More AT means a greater boon.

minstrel.name: Minstrel
minstrel.description: You are a traveling scholar or performer. In civilized settlements, someone may host you. At important locations, ask the GM for one historical fact you heard in a tale or book.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.description: Perform minor true magic. Touch an item to cosmetically alter it, or create crude minor illusions no bigger than yourself.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.description: Choose a spellcasting stat and a school of magic. You may cast spells and make magic rolls using that stat and school. {magic_die_text} Magic has range, target, and effect limits, and the spell must fit your school.

steps.text_value: When you make a magic roll using your chosen spellcasting stat and school, add your current magic die. Magic dice do not explode.
When you make a magic roll using your chosen spellcasting stat and school, add your current. Magic dice do not explode.
When you make a magic roll using your chosen spellcasting stat and school, add your current magic die. Magic dice do not explode.
When you make a magic roll using your chosen spellcasting stat and school, add your current magic die. Magic dice do not explode.

school_savant.name: School Savant
school_savant.description: Choose one additional school of magic. You may cast spells from that school using your spellcasting rules. This can be bought more than once. Each new school costs more than the last.

empowerments.name: Harm Slinger
empowerments.description: When casting on an unwilling living being, you may spend AT to add options such as more area, more range, or damage + effect. The spell must still fit your school, target, and situation.

empowerments.name: Expert Enchanter
empowerments.description: When casting on a willing living being or an object, you may spend AT to add options such as more area, more range, or longer duration. The spell must still fit your school, target, and situation.

magic_novice.name: Magic Novice
magic_novice.description: Choose one specific magical ability you can perform. {magic_die_text}

empowerments.name: Upgrade to Spellcasting
empowerments.description: Replace Magic Novice with full Spellcasting. Keep your relevant spellcasting choice where possible, then choose a magic school. Any matching Magic Novice magic die upgrades should become the matching Spellcasting magic die upgrades.

steps.text_value: Gain a d4 Magic Die. Magic Dice do not explode.
Increase your Magic Die to d6. Magic Dice do not explode.
Increase your Magic Die to d8. Magic Dice do not explode.
Increase your Magic Die to d10. Magic Dice do not explode.

eye_for_weakness.name: Eye for Weakness
eye_for_weakness.description: Spend 1 AT to ask the GM what here is weak or vulnerable. They answer honestly. Attacking the weak area gives advantage and +1 HP damage.

wide_wanderer.name: Wide-Wanderer
wide_wanderer.description: When you arrive somewhere, ask the GM about important traditions, rituals, or customs, and they tell you what you need to know.

mighty.name: Mighty
mighty.description: Whenever you make a physical effort stat check, add your current Mighty die: d{mighty_die}. This applies to forceful physical actions such as lifting, breaking, pushing, climbing, holding, wrestling, or other athletic challenges, with GM approval. You may also treat one athletic challenge as lesser when appropriate. Mighty dice do not explode.

torturer.name: Torturer
torturer.description: When you parley using threats of impending violence as leverage, you have advantage.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Whenever you gain AT from taking damage, gain +{extra_at_from_damage} additional AT.

reckless_attack.name: Reckless Attack
reckless_attack.description: On your turn, you can choose to attack recklessly to gain advantage on melee attack rolls this turn. However, attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

shared_pain.name: Shared Pain
shared_pain.description: Clear any amount of marked HP from an ally by marking the same amount of HP on yourself. When you mark damage in this way you get AT as with all other damage

piercer.name: Piercer
piercer.description: Spend 1 AT to make a combat roll against all enemies in a very close line from you. On each hit, inflict disadvantage or deal damage.

baller.name: Baller
baller.description: Spend 1 AT to create a very close radius sphere within close range. Roll against all creatures inside, including allies. On each hit, inflict disadvantage or deal damage.

martyr.name: Martyr
martyr.description: When using the protect action, you may protect an ally in close range instead of only very close range.

defender.name: Defender
defender.description: When using the parry action, you may use it on allies within your current parry range: {parry_range}.

heightened_ability.name: Heightened Ability
heightened_ability.description: Gain a static bonus to one stat. +1 costs 1 IP. To increase to +2, first have +1 then spend 2 IP, and so on.

high_flier.name: High Flier
high_flier.description: You can fly using biological or magical means.

intuitive.name: Intuitive
intuitive.description: Spend 1 AT to ask the GM about your surroundings, an NPC, or similar. The GM must answer honestly.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: Spend 2 AT to reroll a stat check.

nerves_of_steel.name: Nerves of Steel
nerves_of_steel.description: Spend 1 AT to take half of your die's value instead of rolling on a Snap Decision.

skilled_at.name: Skilled At...
skilled_at.description: Choose a non-combat skill with the GM. You succeed on moderately difficult checks, 9 or less, and may add up to +3 on harder checks. Does not stack with other improvement bonuses.

treasure_hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
treasure_hunter.description: Spend 1 AT to find a useful item in your surroundings.

stealthy.name: Stealthy
stealthy.description: Spend 1 AT to avoid being seen, within reason and GM discretion.

utility_belt.name: Utility Belt
utility_belt.description: Spend 1 AT to just happen to have one commonplace item with you, at GM discretion.

spirited_motivator.name: Spirited Motivator
spirited_motivator.description: When helping a crewmate, each AT you spend gives +2 instead of +1. You may spend AT to help when absent if they describe a previous pep talk.

custom.name: Custom Improvement...
custom.description: Create an improvement with a custom name, description, and IP cost.
